comment: The three output rows are not in index order: the top row reads pitch, gate and velocity, which are indices 0, 5 and 3, and the row below reads the second pitch, aftertouch and release velocity, indices 1, 2 and 4. The second pitch jack has no family because what it carries depends on the mode: 1V per octave in the polyphonic modes and a controller CV in the MPE ones. configParam is called twice for the data knob (src/MIDIpolyMPE.cpp:190-191) with different ranges; the second call wins, so the knob runs 0 to 1. The names Rack shows on the second pitch, aftertouch, release velocity and the eight controller jacks are rewritten at run time (src/MIDIpolyMPE.cpp:342-349), so the census names are whatever was assigned when it was taken. The module runs its MIDI and output code once every half a millisecond rather than every sample (src/MIDIpolyMPE.cpp:1275).
